pred_ddx.label: Paradoxical movement of the interventricular septum

Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD): The patient's symptoms, such as syncope, and echocardiogram results, including an abnormal color flow signal arising from the interventricular septum, are consistent with a VSD. The presence of a continuous flow with a predominant diastolic component on Doppler interrogation further supports this diagnosis.
Paradoxical movement of the interventric: Although less likely, paradoxical movement of the interventricular septum could also cause an abnormal color flow signal on the echocardiogram.
